verdict.rationale: Orb has a programmatic surface an agent could drive. It offers a subscription creation API endpoint, subscription edits via the API (add-ons, seats, discounts), and plan changes with proration credits and audit history. Supporting this are SDKs in six languages, idempotency for safe retries, and an llms.txt. However, nothing shows scoped or least-privilege API keys or permissions, and applying a credit is only implied through proration and credit-balance alerts rather than a documented credit endpoint. Missing for 10: scoped/permissioned API keys for agent access, an explicit credit-application endpoint, explicit API-driven plan change docs, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
